channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Duqeyn Israa'iil ah oo ku dhacday Isbitaalka Nasser ee Khan Younis: 6 qof ayaa la sheegay inay dhinteen
item.description: Ugu yaraan 6 qof ayaa la dilay, in ka badan 20 kalena waa ku dhaawacmeen duqeyn cirka ah oo Israa'iil ay Khamiista subaxnimo ku qaadday dhismo ka tirsan Isbitaalka Nasser ee magaalada Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda difaaca madaniga ee Gaza.

item.title: Philip Rivers oo noqonaya tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NC State
item.description: Philip Rivers, oo ahaa ciyaaryahan caan ah oo ka ciyaaray NFL, ayaa oggolaaday inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee jaamacadda NC State, halkaas oo uu horey quarterback uga ahaa, sida ay werisay CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.

item.title: Stephen Curry oo dhaawac caloosha ah ku baxay, Rockets-na 115-108 kaga adkaadeen Warriors
item.description: Xiddigga Golden State Warriors Stephen Curry ayaa Arbacadii ka baxay ciyaartii Houston Rockets rubucii 1-aad kaddib xanuun dhinaca midig ee caloosha ah, Rockets-na waxay ciyaarta ku guuleysteen 115-108.

item.title: Amnesty: QM iyo dowladda Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ka gaabiyay ka hortagga xasuuqii Abiemnom
item.description: Hay'adda Amnesty International ayaa warbixin ay Khamiista soo saartay ku sheegtay in hawlgalka nabad-ilaalinta QM ee Koonfur Suudaan (UNMISS) iyo mas'uuliyiinta dalka ay haysteen digniino ku filan, balse ay ku guuldareysteen inay ka hortagaan weerar 1 March 2026 lagu dilay in ka badan 200 qof oo ku sugnaa Abiemnom.

item.title: Dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku burburay Brooklyn, New York: ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay
item.description: Ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay, in ka badan 17 kalena waa la dhaawacay kaddib markii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku yaal xaafadda Flatbush ee degmada Brooklyn, magaalada New York, uu Arbacadii galabnimo ku dumay goob dhismo oo ag taal, sida ay sheegeen mas'uuliyiinta magaalada.

item.title: Bangiga EBRD oo ballan-qaaday 6 bilyan oo doollar mashaariicda tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo ee Turkiga
item.description: Bangiga Yurub ee Dib-u-dhiska iyo Horumarinta (EBRD) ayaa sheegay inuu shanta sano ee soo socota 6 bilyan oo doollar gelin doono mashaariicda tamarta nadiifka ah ee Turkiga, kadib markii uu ku biiray barnaamij cusub oo lagu daah-furay shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya.

item.title: Jacob Misiorowski oo si wadajir ah ugu guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League
item.description: Ciyaartoyga tuuraha ah ee kooxda Milwaukee Brewers Jacob Misiorowski ayaa Arbacadii lagu dhawaaqay inuu ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2026, isagoo helay dhammaan 30-ka cod ee kaalinta koowaad.

item.title: Saamiyada Nvidia oo hoos u dhacay iyadoo guddiga shirkadda uu ka doodayo mustaqbalka Jensen Huang
item.description: Saamiyada shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Arbacadii ku dhacay in ka badan 8 boqolkiiba ganacsiga saacadaha dambe, kadib warar sheegaya in guddiga agaasimayaasha shirkadda uu ka doodi doono jagada madaxa shirkadda Jensen Huang, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Guatemala oo khatar ugu jira inay waayaan magaca dal ka xorobay jadeecada
item.description: Guddi khubaro caafimaad oo madax-bannaan ayaa toddobaadkan Washington ku eegaya in Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Guatemala ay weli buuxiyaan shuruudaha dalal laga tirtiray faafidda jadeecada, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo gaaray Peru, dalkii uu muddo dheer ka shaqeeyay
item.description: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Arbacadii gaaray Peru, oo ah marxaladdii ugu dambeysay ee socdaalkiisa Koonfurta Ameerika, waxaana soo dhaweeyay kumanaan qof oo u yaqaan "Padre Robert", sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Dimuqraadi Scott Colom oo ku guuleystay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Mississippi
item.description: Musharraxa xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Scott Colom ayaa ku guuleystay doorashada Golaha Guurtida Mareykanka ee gobolka Mississippi, isagoo tiro yar oo codad ah kaga adkaaday Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Svitolina oo dib uga soo kacday kaga adkaatay Muchova, rajada WTA Finals-na ilaashatay
item.description: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 3-6, 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaatay Karolina Muchova tartanka WTA Finals, taasoo u sii daysay fursadda inay u gudubto semi-finalka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Garsoore Mareykan ah oo oggolaaday in dacwadda $10 bilyan ee Trump ka gudbiyay BBC ay socoto
item.description: Garsoore federaal ah oo ku sugan Florida ayaa go'aamiyay in dacwadda sumcad-dilka ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ka gudbiyay BBC, oo uu ku dalbanayo $10 bilyan, ay sii socon karto, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya: Tanaasul farsamo waa diyaar, doorashada qof iyo cod se lagama noqonayo
item.description: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku diyaar u tahay tanaasul ku saabsan arrimaha farsamo ee doorashada, balse aysan ka tanaasuli doonin hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo Jimcaha fasax dadweyne ka dhigtay aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu
item.description: Koonfur Suudaan ayaa Jimcaha, 13 November 2026, ku dhawaaqday fasax dadweyne si muwaadiniintu uga qayb galaan aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya, sida uu sheegay guddiga sare ee qabanqaabada aaska.

item.title: Mareykanka oo kooxdiisa ka saaray Koobka Adduunka ee U-17 ee Qatar walaac amni dartiis
item.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Mareykanka (U.S. Soccer) ayaa go'aansaday inaanu kooxda qaranka ee da'da ka yar 17 u dirin Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA ee U-17 ee Qatar, isagoo sheegay walaac amni oo la xiriira colaadda Bariga Dhexe, sida ay werisay The Athletic.

item.title: War-saxaafadeed: Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol oo sheegay inuusan ka qaybgalin kulan wadajir ah oo mucaarad
item.description: Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa war-saxaafadeed ku sheegay in aysan jirin wararka sheegaya inuu ka qaybgalay kulan wadajir ah oo uu la yeeshay ururro kale oo mucaarad ah, wuxuuna ka warramay booqasho ay Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ku tageen hoyga Madaxweynihii 9aad Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo.

item.title: Iran oo ciidamada badda iyo cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay ciidamada badda iyo ciidamada cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso, taasoo jawaab u ah go'aan Buenos Aires horay uga gaartay Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Xasan Sheekh oo COP31 ka codsaday in dalalka cimilada wasakheeya ay hoggaamiyaan wax ka qabashada saameynteeda
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Arbacadii khudbad ka jeediyay shirweynaha 31-aad ee Qaramada Midoobay ee isbeddelka cimilada (COP31) oo ka furmay magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga, wuxuuna beesha caalamka ugu baaqay inay fuliyaan ballanqaadyadii cimilada, sida ay wariyeen Goobjoog News iyo Radio Muqdisho.

item.title: Kulanka Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy: marin-badeedka iyo madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya
item.description: Kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ee maanta ka dhacay Turkiga wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli labada dal ay weli wajahayaan caqabado diblomaasiyadeed oo ka dhashay murankii marin-badeedka. Mabda'a Soomaaliya waa in madaxbannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed si buuxda loo ixtiraamo.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka: 66 sano oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed, iskaashi iyo saaxiibtinnimo ah
item.description: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka waxay leeyihiin xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo soo taxnaa tan iyo xilligii ay Soomaaliya xorriyadda qaadatay 1-dii Luulyo 1960, kana dhisan saaxiibtinimo, is-ixtiraam, iskaashi iyo danaha labada shacab. Qoraa: Eng Mahad AA.

item.title: Tababarihii hore ee NFL Rex Ryan oo loo soo oogay dacwado kaddib shil lugeyaal ka dhacay Nashville
item.description: Rex Ryan, falanqeeyaha ESPN iyo tababarihii hore ee kooxaha New York Jets iyo Buffalo Bills, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 isu dhiibay booliska Nashville, kaddib markii lagu eedeeyay inuu baabuurkiisa ku dhuftay laba qof oo lugeynayay oo uu goobta ka tagay, sida ay werisay The Guardian.

item.title: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan oo kulan la yeeshay Ra'iisul Wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Khayre
item.description: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Ra'iisul Wasaarihii 19-aad ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre. Waxay ka wada hadleen geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka, dadaallada afarta dhinac ee Türkiye, Maraykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Midowga Yurub, iyo xiriirka Türkiye iyo Soomaaliya.

item.title: Safiirka Ruushka u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, oo geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ku dhawaaqday in safiirka dalkaas u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, uu si lama filaan ah u geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Iran oo ku hanjabtay inay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub haddii looga duulo
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 sheegay in Tehran ay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub iyo jasiiradaha fogfog haddii laga adeegsado weerar lagu qaado Iran, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Kenya oo meel mariyay sharci ka mamnuucaya isbitaallada inay bukaanka iyo meydadka hayaan
item.description: Golaha Qaranka ee Kenya ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 meel mariyay sharci mamnuucaya in isbitaalladu ay lacag hore ka dalbadaan bukaanka xaaladaha degdegga ah, ama ay hayaan bukaan iyo meydad biilal aan la bixin awgood, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.

item.title: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Sweden
item.description: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Mohamud Karshe, ayaa xarunta Urur Goboleedka IGAD ee magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Dowladda Sweden u fadhiya Soomaaliya, H.E. Amb. Hans Henric Lundquist, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida.

item.title: England oo baajisay Test-ka haweenka ee West Indies si ay ugu diyaar garowdo Ashes-ka
item.description: Kooxda cricket-ka haweenka England ayaa baajisay ciyaar Test ah oo bisha April looga ciyaari lahaa West Indies, waxayna taa beddelkeeda Ingiriiska ku ciyaari doontaa ciyaaro kubadda cas ah oo ay ugu diyaar garoobayso Ashes-ka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Wasiirka Caddaaladda Soomaaliya oo ka digay khatar ku wajahan dowladnimada, kuna baaqay dib-u-eegis federaalka
item.description: Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ka digay khataraha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka, wuxuuna ku baaqay in dib loo eego nidaamka federaalka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Ergooyinka Trump oo Moskow ugu ambabaxaya Putin kaddib wada-hadallada Abu Dhabi oo aan horumar cad laga gaarin
item.description: Jared Kushner, oo qaba gabadha Madaxweyne Donald Trump, ayaa Arbacada sheegay in isaga iyo ergayga Bariga Dhexe Steve Witkoff ay berri u safri doonaan Moskow si ay ula kulmaan Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin, kaddib markii wada-hadallada saddex-geesoodka ah ee Abu Dhabi ay ku dhammaadeen horumar cad la'aan, sida ay werisay CNN.
